quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰفِلِينَ
إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَٰجِدِينَ
قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَآ أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
۞ لَّقَدْ كَانَ فِى يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ٱقْتُلُوا۟ يُوسُفَ أَوِ ٱطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًۭا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا صَٰلِحِينَ
قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِى غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ ٱلسَّيَّارَةِ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَ۫نَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَنَٰصِحُونَ
أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًۭا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
قَالَ إِنِّى لَيَحْزُنُنِىٓ أَن تَذْهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَخَافُ أَن يَأْكُلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ وَأَنتُمْ عَنْهُ غَٰفِلُونَ
قَالُوا۟ لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِى غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
وَجَآءُوٓ أَبَاهُمْ عِشَآءًۭ يَبْكُونَ
قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَآ إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِندَ مَتَٰعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍۢ لَّنَا وَلَوْ كُنَّا صَٰدِقِينَ
وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٍۢ كَذِبٍۢ ۚ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًۭا ۖ فَصَبْرٌۭ جَمِيلٌۭ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
وَجَآءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌۭ فَأَرْسَلُوا۟ وَارِدَهُمْ فَأَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ يَٰبُشْرَىٰ هَٰذَا غُلَٰمٌۭ ۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَٰعَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍۭ بَخْسٍۢ دَرَٰهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍۢ وَكَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥٓ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

وَرَٰوَدَتْهُ ٱلَّتِى هُوَ فِى بَيْتِهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَغَلَّقَتِ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ ۚ قَالَ مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَاىَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِۦ ۖ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَآ أَن رَّءَا بُرْهَٰنَ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَٱلْفَحْشَآءَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
وَٱسْتَبَقَا ٱلْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُۥ مِن دُبُرٍۢ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا ٱلْبَابِ ۚ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَآءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوٓءًا إِلَّآ أَن يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
قَالَ هِىَ رَٰوَدَتْنِى عَن نَّفْسِى ۚ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَآ إِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن قُبُلٍۢ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
وَإِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍۢ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
فَلَمَّا رَءَا قَمِيصَهُۥ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍۢ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ مِن كَيْدِكُنَّ ۖ إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌۭ
يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرِى لِذَنۢبِكِ ۖ إِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ ٱلْخَاطِـِٔينَ
۞ وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌۭ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ تُرَٰوِدُ فَتَىٰهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۖ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا ۖ إِنَّا لَنَرَىٰهَا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَعْتَدَتْ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَـًۭٔا وَءَاتَتْ كُلَّ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ مِّنْهُنَّ سِكِّينًۭا وَقَالَتِ ٱخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْنَهُۥٓ أَكْبَرْنَهُۥ وَقَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلْنَ حَٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا هَٰذَا بَشَرًا إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا مَلَكٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
قَالَتْ فَذَٰلِكُنَّ ٱلَّذِى لُمْتُنَّنِى فِيهِ ۖ وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ فَٱسْتَعْصَمَ ۖ وَلَئِن لَّمْ يَفْعَلْ مَآ ءَامُرُهُۥ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰغِرِينَ
قَالَ رَبِّ ٱلسِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّى كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ فَصَرَفَ عَنْهُ كَيْدَهُنَّ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُۥ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ ٱلسِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ ۖ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَآ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰنِىٓ أَعْصِرُ خَمْرًۭا ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْءَاخَرُ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰنِىٓ أَحْمِلُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِى خُبْزًۭا تَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّيْرُ مِنْهُ ۖ نَبِّئْنَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌۭ تُرْزَقَانِهِۦٓ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِى رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنِّى تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ

وَٱتَّبَعْتُ مِلَّةَ ءَابَآءِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۚ مَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نُّشْرِكَ بِٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
يَٰصَىٰحِبَىِ ٱلسِّجْنِ ءَأَرْبَابٌۭ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيْرٌ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءًۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۚ أَمَرَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
يَٰصَىٰحِبَىِ ٱلسِّجْنِ أَمَّآ أَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسْقِى رَبَّهُۥ خَمْرًۭا ۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلْءَاخَرُ فَيُصْلَبُ فَتَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّيْرُ مِن رَّأْسِهِۦ ۚ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ تَسْتَفْتِيَانِ
وَقَالَ لِلَّذِى ظَنَّ أَنَّهُۥ نَاجٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا ٱذْكُرْنِى عِندَ رَبِّكَ فَأَنسَىٰهُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِى ٱلسِّجْنِ بِضْعَ سِنِينَ

وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ سَبْعَ بَقَرَٰتٍۢ سِمَانٍۢ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌۭ وَسَبْعَ سُنۢبُلَٰتٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَٰتٍۢ ۖ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِى فِى رُءْيَٰىَ إِن كُنتُمْ لِلرُّءْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ
قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۢ ۖ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحْلَٰمِ بِعَٰلِمِينَ
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى نَجَا مِنْهُمَا وَٱدَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ أَنَا۠ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِتَأْوِيلِهِۦ فَأَرْسِلُونِ

يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنَا فِى سَبْعِ بَقَرَٰتٍۢ سِمَانٍۢ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌۭ وَسَبْعِ سُنۢبُلَٰتٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَٰتٍۢ لَّعَلِّىٓ أَرْجِعُ إِلَى ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
قَالَ تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَأَبًۭا فَمَا حَصَدتُّمْ فَذَرُوهُ فِى سُنۢبُلِهِۦٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ
ثُمَّ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ سَبْعٌۭ شِدَادٌۭ يَأْكُلْنَ مَا قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّمَّا تُحْصِنُونَ
ثُمَّ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَامٌۭ فِيهِ يُغَاثُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ
وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱئْتُونِى بِهِۦ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُ ٱلرَّسُولُ قَالَ ٱرْجِعْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَسْـَٔلْهُ مَا بَالُ ٱلنِّسْوَةِ ٱلَّٰتِى قَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى بِكَيْدِهِنَّ عَلِيمٌۭ

قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٰٔنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ذَٰلِكَ لِيَعْلَمَ أَنِّى لَمْ أَخُنْهُ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى كَيْدَ ٱلْخَآئِنِينَ
۞ وَمَآ أُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِىٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلنَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌۢ بِٱلسُّوٓءِ إِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱئْتُونِى بِهِۦٓ أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ لِنَفْسِى ۖ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهُۥ قَالَ إِنَّكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ لَدَيْنَا مَكِينٌ أَمِينٌۭ
قَالَ ٱجْعَلْنِى عَلَىٰ خَزَآئِنِ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنِّى حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَتَبَوَّأُ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ يَشَآءُ ۚ نُصِيبُ بِرَحْمَتِنَا مَن نَّشَآءُ ۖ وَلَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
وَجَآءَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
وَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ قَالَ ٱئْتُونِى بِأَخٍۢ لَّكُم مِّنْ أَبِيكُمْ ۚ أَلَا تَرَوْنَ أَنِّىٓ أُوفِى ٱلْكَيْلَ وَأَنَا۠ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
فَإِن لَّمْ تَأْتُونِى بِهِۦ فَلَا كَيْلَ لَكُمْ عِندِى وَلَا تَقْرَبُونِ
قَالُوا۟ سَنُرَٰوِدُ عَنْهُ أَبَاهُ وَإِنَّا لَفَٰعِلُونَ
وَقَالَ لِفِتْيَٰنِهِ ٱجْعَلُوا۟ بِضَٰعَتَهُمْ فِى رِحَالِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْرِفُونَهَآ إِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِيهِمْ قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَا مُنِعَ مِنَّا ٱلْكَيْلُ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَآ أَخَانَا نَكْتَلْ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
قَالَ هَلْ ءَامَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا كَمَآ أَمِنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَخِيهِ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَٰفِظًۭا ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا۟ مَتَٰعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا۟ بِضَٰعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَا مَا نَبْغِى ۖ هَٰذِهِۦ بِضَٰعَتُنَا رُدَّتْ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَنَمِيرُ أَهْلَنَا وَنَحْفَظُ أَخَانَا وَنَزْدَادُ كَيْلَ بَعِيرٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ كَيْلٌۭ يَسِيرٌۭ

قَالَ لَنْ أُرْسِلَهُۥ مَعَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لَتَأْتُنَّنِى بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يُحَاطَ بِكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّآ ءَاتَوْهُ مَوْثِقَهُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌۭ

وَقَالَ يَٰبَنِىَّ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ مِنۢ بَابٍۢ وَٰحِدٍۢ وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ مِنْ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ مُّتَفَرِّقَةٍۢ ۖ وَمَآ أُغْنِى عَنكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَعَلَيْهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُم مَّا كَانَ يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا حَاجَةًۭ فِى نَفْسِ يَعْقُوبَ قَضَىٰهَا ۚ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذُو عِلْمٍۢ لِّمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَخَاهُ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ أَخُوكَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ جَعَلَ ٱلسِّقَايَةَ فِى رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا ٱلْعِيرُ إِنَّكُمْ لَسَٰرِقُونَ
قَالُوا۟ وَأَقْبَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِم مَّاذَا تَفْقِدُونَ
قَالُوا۟ نَفْقِدُ صُوَاعَ ٱلْمَلِكِ وَلِمَن جَآءَ بِهِۦ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍۢ وَأَنَا۠ بِهِۦ زَعِيمٌۭ
قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا جِئْنَا لِنُفْسِدَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كُنَّا سَٰرِقِينَ
قَالُوا۟ فَمَا جَزَٰٓؤُهُۥٓ إِن كُنتُمْ كَٰذِبِينَ
قَالُوا۟ جَزَٰٓؤُهُۥ مَن وُجِدَ فِى رَحْلِهِۦ فَهُوَ جَزَٰٓؤُهُۥ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ ۖ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِى دِينِ ٱلْمَلِكِ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ مَّن نَّشَآءُ ۗ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِى عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
۞ قَالُوٓا۟ إِن يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌۭ لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ أَنتُمْ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ
قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُۥٓ أَبًۭا شَيْخًۭا كَبِيرًۭا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُۥٓ ۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
قَالَ مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِ أَن نَّأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَن وَجَدْنَا مَتَٰعَنَا عِندَهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّظَٰلِمُونَ

فَلَمَّا ٱسْتَيْـَٔسُوا۟ مِنْهُ خَلَصُوا۟ نَجِيًّۭا ۖ قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُم مَّوْثِقًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطتُمْ فِى يُوسُفَ ۖ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ ٱلْأَرْضَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْذَنَ لِىٓ أَبِىٓ أَوْ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ لِى ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
ٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَآ إِنَّ ٱبْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَآ إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَٰفِظِينَ
وَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنَّا فِيهَا وَٱلْعِيرَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا ۖ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًۭا ۖ فَصَبْرٌۭ جَمِيلٌ ۖ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِى بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌۭ
قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا۟ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْهَٰلِكِينَ
قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
يَٰبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا ٱلضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَٰعَةٍۢ مُّزْجَىٰةٍۢ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا ٱلْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجْزِى ٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ
قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنتُمْ جَٰهِلُونَ
قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ يُوسُفُ وَهَٰذَآ أَخِى ۖ قَدْ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَٰطِـِٔينَ
قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ٱذْهَبُوا۟ بِقَمِيصِى هَٰذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ أَبِى يَأْتِ بَصِيرًۭا وَأْتُونِى بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ
قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِى ضَلَٰلِكَ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَا ٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا خَٰطِـِٔينَ
قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مِصْرَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ

وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا۟ لَهُۥ سُجَّدًۭا ۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ هَٰذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُءْيَٰىَ مِن قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّى حَقًّۭا ۖ وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِىٓ إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِى مِنَ ٱلسِّجْنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْبَدْوِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن نَّزَغَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِىٓ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَطِيفٌۭ لِّمَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

۞ رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ
وَمَآ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَمَا تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
وَكَأَيِّن مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُم بِٱللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ
أَفَأَمِنُوٓا۟ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَٰشِيَةٌۭ مِّنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
قُلْ هَٰذِهِۦ سَبِيلِىٓ أَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا۠ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِى ۖ وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۗ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ٱسْتَيْـَٔسَ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا۟ جَآءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّىَ مَن نَّشَآءُ ۖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

لَقَدْ كَانَ فِى قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌۭ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًۭا يُفْتَرَىٰ وَلَٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ

parent_channels.name: P1 (12:1-18): Signs assembled into disclosure

subchannels.name: Joined inscription and gathered recitation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marks are joined into writing, gathered in recitation, articulated, and made explanatory.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining one thing to another `quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`; written letter-order `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; gathering `quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`; reading and recitation `quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`; clear articulation `quranic:root_000996:B001/m01`; disclosure by speech or sign `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The opening presents intelligibility as construction. Elements are joined into a written body and gathered again in recitation; articulation then carries that assembled form into disclosed meaning.

subchannels.name: Hidden sequence made legible
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed communication is traced as a sequential report until its signs become cognitively available.
subchannels.active_motifs: following a trace `quranic:root_001232:B001/m01`; sequential narration `quranic:root_001232:B002/m01`; hidden imparting of knowledge `quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`; writing or engraving `quranic:root_001633:B003/m01`; divine report and inspiration `quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`; unveiling `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; reason restraining ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`; visible sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Narration operates like trace-following: a hidden deposit is carried in ordered stages until it becomes visible as a sign and available to disciplined understanding. The latent engraving image gives the report material persistence.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Dispersed marks become an ordered transmission whose hidden source is made intelligible.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Writing is also an act of joining, reading is gathering, and revelation can be imagined as a hidden inscription.

parent_channels.name: P1 (12:1-18): Hierarchy announced and resisted

subchannels.name: Celestial bodies bend into an ordered field
subchannels.scene_or_process: Counted lights gather around the dreamer and lower themselves toward him.
subchannels.active_motifs: dream vision `quranic:root_000531:B003/m01`; star `quranic:root_001331:B001/m01`; sun `quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`; moon `quranic:root_001255:B001/m01`; ten as counted completion `quranic:root_001016:B001/m01`; lowering and submission `quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`; bending the head `quranic:root_000675:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The dream composes a numbered sky into a directed posture. Light-bearing bodies become participants in a hierarchy, and their bending converts a cosmic arrangement into a relational forecast.

subchannels.name: Kinship hardens into a rival band
subchannels.scene_or_process: Affection inside a household is recoded as unequal allocation, prompting siblings to bind themselves into an oppositional bloc.
subchannels.active_motifs: parental nurture `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`; tether and bond `quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`; love attached to the heart `quranic:root_000286:B002/m01`; heart's dark core `quranic:root_000286:B004/m01`; winding and binding `quranic:root_001018:B002/m01`; mutually supporting band `quranic:root_001018:B004/m01`; intrigue `quranic:root_001334:B002/m01`; enmity `quranic:root_000993:B003/m01`; rebellious distance `quranic:root_000796:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The household bond does not disappear; it is retied as a band around a grievance. The latent rope imagery of siblinghood and coalition materializes how intimacy can be tightened into coordinated hostility.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A future ordering of relations is first displayed symbolically and then opposed through a rival human alignment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Celestial bending and a tightly wound human band are opposed bodily forms of alignment.

parent_channels.name: P1 (12:1-18): Concealment converted into retrieval

subchannels.name: Disposal into a cut-off cavity
subchannels.scene_or_process: The victim is moved from contemplated death to casting into a deep, unlined, concealing structure.
subchannels.active_motifs: killing `quranic:root_001200:B001/m01`; throwing away `quranic:root_000929:B001/m01`; casting down `quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`; unlined deep well `quranic:root_000214:B009/m01`; concealment from sight `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`; low cavity in which something disappears `quranic:root_001117:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The revised plan preserves the force of removal while replacing death with spatial disappearance. Lexically, the well is not just scenery but an engineered cavity that holds the body outside ordinary sight.

subchannels.name: Accidental pickup by a moving company
subchannels.scene_or_process: What has been cast away becomes a find that a passing group can take up without prior design.
subchannels.active_motifs: picking up a discarded thing `quranic:root_001369:B001/m01`; encountering unexpectedly `quranic:root_001369:B002/m01`; an abandoned object `quranic:root_001372:B006/m01`; travelling company `quranic:root_000769:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The same act that makes Joseph socially discarded makes him materially retrievable. Chance encounter is the mechanism by which the concealed person is re-entered into circulation.

subchannels.name: A hidden report planted before recognition
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge of a future disclosure is deposited in the concealed subject while the agents remain unaware.
subchannels.active_motifs: hidden imparting `quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`; divine inspiration `quranic:root_001633:B004/m01`; delivered report `quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`; concealment from sight `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment acquires a counter-channel: while the body is hidden, a future report is installed. The pit therefore holds not only a person but an unrecognized disclosure that will later reverse the agents' knowledge.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Removal into a hidden cavity does not terminate the subject; it changes the route by which he will be recovered and known.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A well is simultaneously a cut-off depth, a hiding chamber, and a transfer point to an unintended moving community.

parent_channels.name: P1 (12:1-18): Fabricated evidence and disciplined counter-reading

subchannels.name: Pastoral freedom becomes a predation alibi
subchannels.scene_or_process: Promised pasture, play, and guardianship are rearranged into a story of distraction and animal consumption.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad pasture `quranic:root_000538:B001/m01`; purposeless play `quranic:root_001358:B001/m01`; guarding `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; predatory wolf `quranic:root_000505:B002/m01`; lapse outside vigilance `quranic:root_001097:B001/m01`; prey prepared for eating `quranic:root_000043:B007/m01`; racing ahead `quranic:root_000671:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The alibi reuses each term of the permission request. Open pasture becomes the setting, play becomes distraction, guardianship becomes failed vigilance, and the wolf supplies a complete predation script.

subchannels.name: A textile surface is made to speak falsely
subchannels.scene_or_process: Feigned grief, a colored garment, inward invention, and descriptive speech are patched into a material claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: feigned crying `quranic:root_000146:B004/m01`; worn shirt `quranic:root_001256:B001/m01`; blood-red coloring `quranic:root_000490:B003/m01`; deceptive colored cloth `quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`; self-adornment of an affair `quranic:root_000763:B002/m01`; inward intention `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; descriptive attribution `quranic:root_001654:B001/m01`; mending holes or marks in cloth `quranic:root_001369:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The shirt is recruited as a witness, but its evidential voice is manufactured. The latent cloth senses of falsehood and pickup add coloring and patchwork to the scene: disparate marks are repaired into a plausible-looking surface.

subchannels.name: Restraint reads through the staged surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inwardly fashioned description is met by self-restraint and appeal for assistance.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding the self from panic `quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`; aid and support `quranic:root_001064:B001/m01`; falsehood opposed to truth `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`; inward intention `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; descriptive attribution `quranic:root_001654:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The answer does not accept the displayed token at face value. It locates fabrication in the inward self, distinguishes description from reality, and answers the epistemic pressure with restraint rather than reactive closure.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Outward signs can be staged, so truthful judgment depends on reading operations and inward discipline rather than immediacy alone.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The false report behaves like textile work: picked-up fragments, coloring, covering, and description are assembled into a deceptive surface.

parent_channels.name: P2 (12:19-35): Recovery changes social classification

subchannels.name: Water equipment extracts an unexpected youth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A moving group sends a water-seeker whose descending bucket returns with a human find.
subchannels.active_motifs: travelling company `quranic:root_000769:B006/m01`; arrival at water `quranic:root_001640:B001/m01`; well bucket `quranic:root_000485:B001/m01`; dangling from above `quranic:root_000485:B010/m01`; news that opens the skin with joy `quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`; youthful boyhood `quranic:root_001103:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: A routine water operation becomes a recovery mechanism. The bucket mediates between depth and surface, while the cry of good news immediately reclassifies what emerged as a valuable find.

subchannels.name: The find is hidden inside market accounting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Concealment converts the youth into merchandise, then valuation compresses him into a deficient counted price.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward concealment `quranic:root_000697:B001/m01`; trade commodity `quranic:root_000123:B002/m01`; sale-purchase exchange `quranic:root_000792:B001/m01`; price and compensation `quranic:root_000206:B001/m01`; diminution of due value `quranic:root_000087:B001/m01`; dirham currency `quranic:root_000472:B001/m01`; counting `quranic:root_000989:B001/m01`; contentment with little and lack of desire `quranic:root_000649:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The hidden person is made legible to commerce through a series of reductions: commodity, price, deficiency, currency, count. Market precision here does not secure just value; it makes undervaluation administratively neat.

subchannels.name: Commodity becomes resident and possible child
subchannels.scene_or_process: Purchase is followed by lodging, anticipated benefit, adoption language, and eventual empowerment.
subchannels.active_motifs: sale-purchase exchange `quranic:root_000792:B001/m01`; lodging and guest-place `quranic:root_000211:B002/m01`; child by descent `quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`; young person or owned dependent `quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`; benefit `quranic:root_001536:B001/m01`; empowerment `quranic:root_001439:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The household reverses the market's flattening without yet ending possession. The same youth is installed as guest, useful dependent, and possible child; the latent frame therefore holds adoption and mastery in unresolved proximity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Extraction from hidden depth is followed by successive acts of naming and placement that recode a person as find, commodity, and household member.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A single ascent from the well passes through water equipment, market accounting, and domestic lodging.

parent_channels.name: P2 (12:19-35): Maturation joins strength to judgment

subchannels.name: Capacity reaches its limit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Growth arrives at a terminal point of strength and readiness to receive.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival at a limit `quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`; attainment of mature strength `quranic:root_000782:B004/m01`; bestowal `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Maturity is modeled as completed arrival rather than mere elapsed time. Reaching strength opens into reception, so capacity is defined by what it can responsibly bear.

subchannels.name: Right judgment is granted as recompense
subchannels.scene_or_process: Accurate judgment and disclosed knowledge are bestowed within a recurring economy of good action and return.
subchannels.active_motifs: right wisdom `quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`; knowledge unveiled to the knower `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; recompense for action `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; beneficent action `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The inward equipment of adulthood is juridical and epistemic. Judgment prevents force from becoming mere impulse, while knowledge and recompense bind capability to a moral process.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Reaching full capacity is completed by an inward grant of discriminating knowledge and a pattern of recompense.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Bodily completion is not treated as self-sufficient; it becomes the receiving structure for judgment.

parent_channels.name: P2 (12:19-35): Enclosure competes with protection

subchannels.name: Locked solicitation narrows the field of action
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated solicitation is reinforced by sealed entrances, adhesive attachment, coercive narrowing, summons, and formed intention.
subchannels.active_motifs: contesting another's will `quranic:root_000610:B002/m01`; tightly locked door `quranic:root_001101:B001/m01`; ensnared attachment `quranic:root_001101:B002/m01`; coercive closure `quranic:root_001101:B006/m01`; entrance `quranic:root_000163:B001/m01`; formula of summons `quranic:root_001611:B002/m01`; intention formed inwardly `quranic:root_001602:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Desire is given architecture. Solicitation does not remain verbal; doors, attachment, and pressure reduce exits until another will is expected to conform to the enclosure.

subchannels.name: Proof diverts and protective holding resists
subchannels.scene_or_process: A disclosed proof redirects action while protective restraint keeps the subject from visible ugliness.
subchannels.active_motifs: demonstrative proof `quranic:root_000112:B001/m01`; diversion from a direction `quranic:root_000860:B001/m01`; holding that protects `quranic:root_001021:B001/m01`; strap or rope held onto `quranic:root_001021:B002/m01`; ugly harm `quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`; overt obscenity `quranic:root_001134:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Protection is also a boundary operation, but one that preserves agency rather than cancels it. The proof changes direction, and the latent rope image makes resistance a held line inside a coercive room.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The same field of holding and closure can coerce access or preserve integrity, depending on who controls the boundary.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Locked doors, ensnaring attachment, and a protective rope share a material grammar of restraint while reversing its ethical direction.

parent_channels.name: P2 (12:19-35): Garment preserves the direction of action

subchannels.name: Chase leaves a longitudinal trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two bodies race toward an exit, producing a lengthwise tear whose front-back orientation retains the chase.
subchannels.active_motifs: racing `quranic:root_000671:B001/m01`; entrance and exit boundary `quranic:root_000163:B001/m01`; longitudinal tear `quranic:root_001204:B001/m01`; shirt covering `quranic:root_001256:B001/m01`; rear side `quranic:root_000458:B001/m01`; facing side `quranic:root_001198:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Motion writes itself into cloth. Because the tear has direction, the garment retains the relative positions of pursuer and pursued after speech begins to compete over the event.

subchannels.name: A material sign testifies by discrimination
subchannels.scene_or_process: Testimony reads the garment's mark, separates alternatives, and assigns truth and falsehood.
subchannels.active_motifs: testimony by knowledge `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; sign that bears witness `quranic:root_000822:B008/m01`; truthful speech `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`; falsehood `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`; visual inspection `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; discriminating separation `quranic:root_001204:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The witness does not add another unsupported claim; he supplies a rule for reading the trace. The latent discriminating sense of the cut turns damage into an evidentiary fork that tests each account.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A damaged surface records movement, and its orientation can be read as testimony about opposed claims.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A tear becomes both a physical cut and an analytic procedure that separates rival narratives.

parent_channels.name: P2 (12:19-35): Desire is converted into public spectacle

subchannels.name: City speech penetrates the heart
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group circulates a report that figures solicitation as love reaching the heart's enclosure.
subchannels.active_motifs: women as a social group `quranic:root_001500:B001/m01`; assembled city `quranic:root_001408:B001/m01`; solicitation `quranic:root_000610:B002/m01`; love reaching the heart sheath `quranic:root_000800:B001/m01`; heart's innermost core `quranic:root_000286:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Gossip does more than announce desire; it anatomizes it. The report moves through the city while describing love as already having moved through the protective layers of the heart.

subchannels.name: Prepared viewing writes astonishment on hands
subchannels.scene_or_process: A viewing arrangement supplies supports and knives, then the sighted body interrupts ordinary hand action through cutting.
subchannels.active_motifs: prepared object `quranic:root_000978:B001/m01`; reclining support `quranic:root_001678:B004/m01`; knife that stills movement `quranic:root_000726:B007/m01`; hand `quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`; severing `quranic:root_001240:B001/m01`; visual perception `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; inward magnification of a person `quranic:root_001281:B003/m01`; visible human body `quranic:root_000120:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The host converts rumor into an experiment of perception. Looking seizes the hands from their intended task, and the latent stilling function of the knife makes astonishment materially interrupt the body.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Private attachment becomes socially contagious by report, staging, looking, and bodily inscription.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A report said to have reached the heart is answered by a staged sight that reaches and cuts the hand.

parent_channels.name: P2 (12:19-35): Prison reverses the value of enclosure

subchannels.name: Bounded refuge is preferred to compelled inclination
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protective holding, threatened inclination, and competing summons make prison the chosen boundary against ignorance.
subchannels.active_motifs: prison confinement `quranic:root_000678:B001/m01`; holding that protects `quranic:root_001021:B001/m01`; youthful inclination of the heart `quranic:root_000843:B002/m01`; verbal summons `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; lack of knowledge `quranic:root_000271:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The desired enclosure is paradoxically protective because it limits access to a coercive invitation. Prison names a loss of movement, but also a preserved capacity not to be moved inwardly.

subchannels.name: Visible signs do not prevent imposed delay
subchannels.scene_or_process: After signs are seen and the scheme is diverted, authorities still choose confinement for an interval.
subchannels.active_motifs: diversion from a course `quranic:root_000860:B001/m01`; intrigue `quranic:root_001334:B002/m01`; visible signs `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; bounded time `quranic:root_000382:B001/m01`; prison confinement `quranic:root_000678:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Evidence settles neither power nor timing. The same boundary that Joseph preferred as moral protection is appropriated by others as a device for postponing the consequences of what they have seen.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Confinement can be chosen as protection from a coercive field and then imposed by that same field as punitive control.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A prison can be the preferable enclosure when an apparently open social space has become more coercive than a cell.

parent_channels.name: P3 (12:36-57): Dream images cross into outcomes

subchannels.name: Prison food appears as compressed fate
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two dreamers present pressing, carrying, bread, head, bird, and eating as compact material scenes.
subchannels.active_motifs: dream vision `quranic:root_000531:B003/m01`; pressure until liquid is extracted `quranic:root_001019:B002/m01`; intoxicating drink `quranic:root_000438:B002/m01`; carrying an exposed load `quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`; head and uppermost part `quranic:root_000529:B001/m01`; bread `quranic:root_000388:B001/m01`; flying bird `quranic:root_000962:B001/m01`; eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Each dream is a small process rather than an isolated emblem. Pressing transforms material into drink, while exposed bread passes from carried provision to avian consumption; these operations already contain the directions of the two outcomes.

subchannels.name: Interpretation transfers surface to terminus
subchannels.scene_or_process: A requested answer crosses from dream form to its return, report, and decisive result.
subchannels.active_motifs: return to final outcome `quranic:root_000067:B002/m01`; transferring a dream from surface to meaning `quranic:root_000974:B002/m01`; clarifying judgment in an answer `quranic:root_001130:B004/m01`; delivered report `quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`; decisive judgment `quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The interpreter carries an image to the place where it returns as event. Answering, reporting, and judging are coordinated acts that prevent interpretation from remaining an associative gloss.

subchannels.name: One image returns as service, the other as exposed death
subchannels.scene_or_process: The paired dreams resolve into restored service for one body and execution followed by consumption for the other.
subchannels.active_motifs: giving drink `quranic:root_000722:B001/m01`; crucifixion for death `quranic:root_000875:B005/m01`; head and uppermost part `quranic:root_000529:B001/m01`; bird `quranic:root_000962:B001/m01`; eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`; death as decisive fate `quranic:root_001237:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Interpretation does not merely predict good and bad. It preserves each dream's mechanics: liquid reaches a lord through service, while bread on a raised head becomes a body exposed to birds.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Image-bearing scenes are transferred from dream surface to executable interpretation and then to materially different fates.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Interpretation is a crossing operation: it carries food, bodies, service, and death from one representational side to another.

parent_channels.name: P3 (12:36-57): Sovereignty is tested by naming

subchannels.name: Scattered lords are opposed to singular mastery
subchannels.scene_or_process: Prison companions are asked to compare divided lordships with unified overpowering rule.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship and close association `quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`; distinction and separation `quranic:root_001148:B001/m01`; lordship and mastery `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; divine unity without partner `quranic:root_001631:B004/m01`; overpowering from above `quranic:root_001266:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The question turns a theological contrast into a structural one. Plural authorities are dispersed, while singular sovereignty combines unity with the force to make judgment operative.

subchannels.name: Names lack rule without warrant
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inherited names are shown to lack compelling proof, while judgment, obedient service, and upright order are reassigned.
subchannels.active_motifs: name as elevated designation `quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`; compelling proof `quranic:root_000732:B002/m01`; judgment between people `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; worshipful obedience `quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`; obedience and submission `quranic:root_000504:B001/m01`; uprightness and equilibrium `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Naming can lift a designation into social visibility, but it cannot supply authority. The scene pressures inherited labels by asking whether they carry proof, judgment, and a coherent direction of obedience.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Claims to rule are evaluated by whether names, obedience, judgment, and compelling authority converge in a single source.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Scattered names can simulate plurality without carrying the weight that would make them governing realities.

parent_channels.name: P3 (12:36-57): Agrarian time becomes storage architecture

subchannels.name: Herd and crop images stage consumption
subchannels.scene_or_process: Counted fat cattle and green ears are paired with lean cattle, dry ears, and eating.
subchannels.active_motifs: sevenfold count `quranic:root_000669:B001/m01`; cattle `quranic:root_000139:B001/m01`; fatness `quranic:root_000744:B001/m01`; emaciation `quranic:root_000986:B001/m01`; grain ear `quranic:root_000746:B001/m01`; fresh green plant `quranic:root_000418:B002/m01`; dried plant `quranic:root_001691:B003/m01`; eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The dream makes time visible as bodies and crops. Abundance and scarcity do not simply alternate; the latter is pictured actively eating the former, which prepares the need for defensive storage.

subchannels.name: Continuous labor leaves grain in its covering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sustained sowing and harvest are coupled with deliberate leaving, while a latent husk image supplies the storage mechanism.
subchannels.active_motifs: cultivating growth `quranic:root_000630:B001/m01`; continuous labor `quranic:root_000456:B001/m01`; cutting the crop `quranic:root_000327:B001/m01`; leaving in place `quranic:root_001638:B003/m01`; grain ear `quranic:root_000746:B001/m01`; grain protected in its husks `quranic:root_001019:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The instruction turns production into preservation. Harvest is intentionally incomplete: grain remains joined to its ear, and the latent protected-husk sense clarifies why leaving is an active storage technology rather than neglect.

subchannels.name: Hard years consume only an exposed reserve
subchannels.scene_or_process: Severe years arrive after the productive interval and eat what was advanced, except a small fortified portion.
subchannels.active_motifs: severity and hardness `quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`; advancing before need `quranic:root_001207:B004/m01`; consuming stored wealth `quranic:root_000043:B004/m01`; preservation inside an enclosing fort `quranic:root_000331:B001/m01`; small quantity `quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Scarcity is treated as an incoming consumer, so the reserve must be divided between what can be spent and what remains enclosed. Fortification gives storage a defensive rather than merely accumulative function.

subchannels.name: Rain and pressure release a renewed yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: Relief descends as rain and is followed by pressure that extracts liquid and useful yield.
subchannels.active_motifs: descending life-giving rain `quranic:root_001118:B001/m01`; relief of the afflicted `quranic:root_001118:B004/m01`; rain-bearing cloud `quranic:root_001019:B003/m01`; pressing until liquid emerges `quranic:root_001019:B002/m01`; extracted gift or yield `quranic:root_001019:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Recovery is not a bare return of good weather. Water arrives from above, pressure works the renewed produce, and stored potential becomes extractable abundance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Temporal knowledge is made actionable by converting abundance into protected form before scarcity can consume it.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Pressing links rain and extracted yield, while the same root supplies the latent image of grain protected inside its husk.

parent_channels.name: P3 (12:36-57): Hidden truth becomes public

subchannels.name: Inquiry returns to the unresolved event
subchannels.scene_or_process: A messenger is sent back with a demand to ask about the earlier grave matter and solicitation.
subchannels.active_motifs: return to a prior state `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; messenger and message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; questioning `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; grave public matter `quranic:root_000421:B003/m01`; solicitation `quranic:root_000610:B002/m01`; disclosure to knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Release is postponed so the event itself can be returned to public attention. The messenger's reversal changes a private scandal into a formal inquiry with named participants and a knowledge-producing question.

subchannels.name: Exoneration separates truth from accusation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Truth is uncovered, established as matching reality, spoken, and separated from the accused self.
subchannels.active_motifs: truth uncovered `quranic:root_000326:B001/m01`; reality-matching truth `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; establishment of truth `quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`; truthful speech `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`; innocence as separation `quranic:root_000099:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Exoneration is a differentiating action. The uncovered account is matched to reality, made verbally explicit, and detached from the person on whom the false claim had been placed.

subchannels.name: Hidden betrayal is opposed by guided inward government
subchannels.scene_or_process: Conduct in absence is tested against betrayal, while the self's command toward ugliness is held inside mercy and forgiveness.
subchannels.active_motifs: breach of trust `quranic:root_000449:B001/m01`; concealment from sight `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`; gentle direction to truth `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; inward reason and intention `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; command and obligation `quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`; ugliness `quranic:root_000755:B001/m01`; mercy and tenderness `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; covering a fault and its effect `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Public innocence does not erase inward vulnerability. The scene distinguishes fidelity when unseen from the self's pressure toward harm, then locates effective inward government within mercy rather than self-acquittal.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A buried event is reopened through return, questioning, testimony, exoneration, and disclosure of inward agency.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Truth does not merely emerge; it is moved until it settles, while innocence is figured as separation from a contaminating claim.

parent_channels.name: P3 (12:36-57): Knowledge becomes stewardship

subchannels.name: Dialogue yields selected trust
subchannels.scene_or_process: Direct speech permits exclusive selection into a secure station.
subchannels.active_motifs: exclusive selection `quranic:root_000430:B004/m01`; intelligible speech joining interlocutors `quranic:root_001316:B001/m01`; station and standing `quranic:root_001439:B004/m01`; inward security and trust `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Speech here is performative evidence. Once competence is heard in dialogue, the speaker is separated out for a position defined jointly by standing and trust.

subchannels.name: Storehouses require a knowing custodian
subchannels.scene_or_process: Appointment to the land's repositories joins preservation, stored goods, and knowledgeable oversight.
subchannels.active_motifs: appointing into a condition `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`; securing a stored thing `quranic:root_000406:B001/m01`; custodian of stores `quranic:root_000406:B003/m01`; active guarding `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; land as the lower inhabited ground `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The office is defined by an object and an operation: repositories must remain secure. Knowledge is therefore not ornamental qualification but the capacity to preserve material systems across time.

subchannels.name: Empowerment distributes mercy without losing reward
subchannels.scene_or_process: Capacity in the land is framed as directed mercy whose benefits and recompense are not allowed to disappear.
subchannels.active_motifs: empowerment `quranic:root_001439:B005/m01`; mercy and beneficence `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; loss and disappearance `quranic:root_000923:B001/m01`; recompense for labor `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; beneficent action `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`; placing oneself under protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Empowerment is interpreted through circulation rather than possession. Mercy reaches whom it will, while the language of non-loss and wage gives good action a protected continuity beyond the office itself.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Demonstrated speech and knowledge are converted into trusted station, custodial work, and durable public benefit.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The path from private interpretation to public office ends not in display but in the hidden labor of guarding stores.

parent_channels.name: P4 (12:58-76): Recognition is routed through provision and return

subchannels.name: Recognition is asymmetrically distributed
subchannels.scene_or_process: Entering brothers are identified from traces while the identifier remains outside their recognition.
subchannels.active_motifs: recognition by trace or sign `quranic:root_001002:B003/m01`; absence of recognition `quranic:root_001550:B001/m01`; entry into an interior `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Kinship and cognition have separated. Joseph can read the marks of sibling identity, while position, time, and appearance prevent the same recognition from returning toward him.

subchannels.name: Measure and hospitality condition access
subchannels.scene_or_process: Travel equipment, full measure, guest provision, food supply, and camel-load establish the terms for another arrival.
subchannels.active_motifs: prepared travel equipment `quranic:root_000270:B001/m01`; measuring food `quranic:root_001335:B001/m01`; full completion without deficiency `quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`; provision prepared for a guest `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`; imported food supply `quranic:root_001460:B001/m01`; camel `quranic:root_000132:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Hospitality is calibrated. Equipment and measure sustain the travellers, but the promise of future provision also sets a condition that can draw the absent brother into the next journey.

subchannels.name: Restored goods carry a delayed instruction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Merchandise is placed inside travel possessions so that recognition after return will generate another return.
subchannels.active_motifs: trade goods `quranic:root_000123:B002/m01`; lodging-place and travel possessions `quranic:root_000551:B004/m01`; saddle or load-frame `quranic:root_000551:B002/m01`; placing into a condition `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`; recognition from a sign `quranic:root_001002:B003/m01`; turning back toward a destination `quranic:root_001248:B005/m01`; restoration to a former holder `quranic:root_000555:B001/m01`; return within exchange `quranic:root_000555:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The goods function as a material utterance with delayed delivery. Hidden in the load, they become recognizable only at home, where restored possession supplies both surprise and motive for renewed travel.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material provisioning regulates who can return, what can be recognized, and how concealed identity acts across repeated journeys.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Goods inside baggage become a delayed message whose recognition occurs only after the recipients reverse direction.

parent_channels.name: P4 (12:58-76): Custody is built as layered trust

subchannels.name: Withholding tests claims of guardianship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Future measure is blocked unless the family can again claim and negotiate safe custody.
subchannels.active_motifs: barrier between a person and an aim `quranic:root_001448:B002/m01`; active guardianship `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; heart settled in trust `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; compassionate care `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; measured food `quranic:root_001335:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Provision becomes the instrument by which an old guardianship failure is reopened. Claims of protection must now bear a condition, while ultimate custody is explicitly relocated beyond the claimants.

subchannels.name: Covenant binds against encircling loss
subchannels.scene_or_process: A confirmed pledge is imagined as a binding cord set against forces that could surround and overpower the travellers.
subchannels.active_motifs: confirmed covenant `quranic:root_001623:B004/m01`; cord or bond used for fastening `quranic:root_001623:B003/m01`; encirclement by overpowering force `quranic:root_000372:B006/m01`; protective surrounding `quranic:root_000372:B002/m01`; guarantor who keeps an affair `quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`; active guarding `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The pledge gives speech a material form: it fastens the group to an obligation. Yet the exception of encirclement acknowledges that a human cord cannot master every enclosing force.

subchannels.name: Distributed gates serve inward reliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Entry is dispersed across gates as a practical response, while judgment and reliance remain located elsewhere.
subchannels.active_motifs: dividing a structure into gates `quranic:root_000163:B002/m01`; dispersion into parts `quranic:root_001148:B002/m01`; reliance and entrusting `quranic:root_001681:B002/m01`; judgment `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; inward need `quranic:root_000367:B001/m01`; inward intention `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The divided entrances are neither magic nor empty gesture. They satisfy a real inward need while remaining subordinate to judgment and reliance, separating prudent distribution from fantasies of control.

subchannels.name: The vulnerable brother is brought into shelter
subchannels.scene_or_process: Entry culminates in private shelter, kin recognition, compassionate nearness, and relief from distress.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining a sheltering side `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; tenderness toward one sheltered `quranic:root_000070:B002/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`; grief and apprehension `quranic:root_000079:B003/m01`; entry into an interior `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The custody problem briefly resolves as nearness rather than contract. The brother passes from guarded transport into a sheltering relation in which identity is privately restored.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human guardianship is tested and reinforced by withholding, pledge, distributed movement, inward reliance, and shelter.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Trust is alternately a calm heart, a binding cord, an encircling danger, and delegation to one who can actually keep the charge.

parent_channels.name: P4 (12:58-76): Evidence is planted, announced, and searched

subchannels.name: A cup is secured inside transport equipment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A drinking-measure is placed and fastened inside a saddle-load before departure.
subchannels.active_motifs: giving drink `quranic:root_000722:B001/m01`; cup or measure `quranic:root_000892:B004/m01`; saddle and load-frame `quranic:root_000551:B002/m01`; securing a saddle `quranic:root_000551:B003/m01`; placing into a condition `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The hidden item is selected for semantic mobility. As cup and measure it belongs to provisioning; as an insert in travel equipment it can later be discovered as apparently possessed cargo.

subchannels.name: Public accusation creates a guaranteed search economy
subchannels.scene_or_process: An announcement attributes theft, names a missing item, offers a load as reward, and guarantees payment.
subchannels.active_motifs: public notification `quranic:root_000022:B003/m01`; provision-bearing caravan `quranic:root_001066:B007/m01`; attribution of theft `quranic:root_000700:B005/m01`; loss after presence `quranic:root_001168:B001/m01`; search for an absent thing `quranic:root_001168:B002/m01`; carried load `quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`; camel `quranic:root_000132:B001/m01`; guarantee and surety `quranic:root_000633:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The planted object becomes actionable only after public speech supplies a role, a lack, and an incentive. Announcement turns private placement into a collective search governed by accusation and guarantee.

subchannels.name: Search order controls discovery
subchannels.scene_or_process: Containers are inspected in a selected order until the hidden object is found and extracted.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning with a chosen first point `quranic:root_000090:B001/m01`; enclosing a thing in a container `quranic:root_001664:B002/m01`; precedence and ordered advance `quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`; finding `quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`; bringing a hidden thing out `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`; sibling relation `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Discovery is not left to chance. The order delays the expected find, gives the inspection procedural shape, and makes the final extraction appear to complete an impartial search.

subchannels.name: Penalty makes the found possessor stand for the loss
subchannels.scene_or_process: The agreed consequence attaches recompense to the person in whose load the object is found.
subchannels.active_motifs: recompense for an act `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; one thing standing in place of another `quranic:root_000244:B002/m01`; withholding a right `quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`; finding `quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`; saddle-load `quranic:root_000551:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The answer supplied by the brothers creates a substitution rule: the found possessor becomes the penalty. Located custody of the object is made to stand in for liability for its loss.

subchannels.name: Stratagem stages capture and rank
subchannels.scene_or_process: A designed sequence enables seizure outside ordinary royal law and is disclosed as a graded operation of knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: capture and arrest `quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`; royal sovereignty `quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`; stratagem `quranic:root_001334:B002/m01`; drawing forward degree by degree `quranic:root_000468:B003/m01`; elevation of rank `quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The capture depends on a staged legal route, not merely a hidden cup. The latent step-by-step sense of degree clarifies the method: placement, announcement, self-declared penalty, search order, and seizure form a graded design.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A hidden object is made socially effective through placement, public naming, pledged consequence, ordered search, and staged legal capture.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The object is simultaneously cup, measure, cargo insert, missing sign, and legal hinge; its meanings are activated in a deliberate sequence.

parent_channels.name: P5 (12:77-93): Speech cannot relocate custody

subchannels.name: Accusation is answered inside before it is disclosed
subchannels.scene_or_process: A theft attribution is received, concealed in the self, and withheld from outward speech under superior knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: attribution of theft `quranic:root_000700:B005/m01`; inward concealment `quranic:root_000697:B001/m01`; inward reason and intention `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; speech held inside the self `quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`; disclosure after concealment `quranic:root_000097:B001/m01`; descriptive attribution `quranic:root_001654:B001/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Joseph does not let accusation dictate immediate disclosure. The response remains an inward utterance, and knowledge creates distance between what others describe and what he chooses to reveal.

subchannels.name: Proposed substitution is refused
subchannels.scene_or_process: The brothers ask that one counted person be taken in place of another, but seizure remains attached to the located object.
subchannels.active_motifs: one in counted composition `quranic:root_000017:B003/m01`; taking possession `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`; capture and arrest `quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`; finding a thing in place `quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`; useful owned goods `quranic:root_001395:B003/m01`; withholding a right `quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Their offer treats bodies as exchangeable units, but the answer refuses to move the consequence away from the place of finding. Substitution would turn seizure into a new withholding of right.

subchannels.name: Despair contracts speech into private counsel
subchannels.scene_or_process: Failed negotiation produces withdrawal into a separated circle of confidential speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: exclusive separation `quranic:root_000430:B004/m02`; confidential counsel `quranic:root_001476:B005/m01`; negotiation over an affair `quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`; severed hope `quranic:root_001690:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: When public persuasion fails, the group changes both space and speech mode. Despair narrows them into a private circle where they can renegotiate obligation among themselves.

subchannels.name: The elder remains fastened by the pledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Prior covenant and acknowledged neglect hold the elder in place until paternal permission or decisive judgment changes the condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: confirmed covenant `quranic:root_001623:B004/m01`; taking hold `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`; neglect that lets a charge be lost `quranic:root_001145:B005/m01`; remaining attached to the ground `quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`; permission `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`; judgment between claims `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The elder treats covenant as a fastening force. Because the brother cannot be transferred, he transfers the consequence to his own location and waits for a legitimate release.

subchannels.name: Testimony marks the boundary of knowledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: The returning group states what it witnessed, disclaims custody of the unseen, and calls town and caravan as corroborating communities.
subchannels.active_motifs: testimony by knowledge `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; hidden absence `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`; guarding `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`; gathered town community `quranic:root_001222:B001/m01`; provision-bearing caravan `quranic:root_001066:B007/m01`; truthful speech `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The testimony is carefully bounded: it affirms the observed charge but refuses omniscience over what was absent. Public communities are invoked not to enlarge knowledge beyond its limit, but to corroborate the route and report.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Concealment, substitution, private counsel, pledge, and testimony can reposition a claim, but they cannot freely transfer a located liability.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech moves between the hidden self, a negotiating circle, and public testimony, while the object and covenant remain stubbornly placed.

parent_channels.name: P5 (12:77-93): Grief is bodily yet mobilizes search

subchannels.name: Grief turns the body and whitens sight
subchannels.scene_or_process: The grieving father turns away as loss roughens the self, changes the eyes, and is held inwardly.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning away `quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`; grief over what has escaped `quranic:root_000032:B001/m01`; whitening `quranic:root_000168:B001/m01`; seeing eye `quranic:root_001069:B001/m01`; inward roughness of grief `quranic:root_000317:B001/m01`; holding grief inside `quranic:root_001303:B001/m01`; holding breath and silence `quranic:root_001303:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Grief is not abstract emotion. It redirects the body, alters the organs of sight, and becomes a pressure held in the interior; the latent breath-holding image makes silence physiological.

subchannels.name: Persistent memory approaches wasting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recurrent recollection is interpreted by observers as a process that could melt the body toward death.
subchannels.active_motifs: recalling after absence `quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`; wasting at the edge of death `quranic:root_000309:B003/m01`; falling into destruction `quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Those around Jacob read memory as attrition. Their warning supplies a bodily trajectory from repeated recall through wasting to disappearance, even though the following response rejects despair.

subchannels.name: Complaint opens into tracking and hope
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inward distress is disclosed to God, retained knowledge issues in a command to track news, and despair is prohibited.
subchannels.active_motifs: voiced complaint `quranic:root_000814:B001/m01`; expression of what was hidden in the self `quranic:root_000083:B002/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; tracking news by the senses `quranic:root_000321:B004/m01`; setting out and going `quranic:root_000522:B006/m01`; relief and rest `quranic:root_000609:B007/m01`; breeze and moving air `quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`; severed hope `quranic:root_001690:B001/m01`; covering the truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Complaint releases concealed pressure without abandoning direction. Knowledge becomes an instruction to move and sense carefully; relief is not passive comfort but a breeze-like opening that keeps search possible.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Loss enters posture, eye, breath, and memory, but its disciplined expression becomes renewed perception and movement rather than final collapse.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Suppressed grief is figured as held breath, while relief carries the latent mobility of a breeze.

parent_channels.name: P5 (12:77-93): Scarcity is met by complete measure

subchannels.name: Reduced goods are pushed through hardship
subchannels.scene_or_process: A harmed household presents weak merchandise and asks that its measure be brought to completion.
subchannels.active_motifs: damage and deficiency `quranic:root_000907:B001/m01`; trade goods `quranic:root_000123:B002/m01`; gentle pushing forward `quranic:root_000625:B001/m01`; a small inadequate thing `quranic:root_000625:B002/m01`; enduring days with little `quranic:root_000625:B003/m01`; food measurement `quranic:root_001335:B001/m01`; completion without deficiency `quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Scarcity is visible in the quality and motion of the goods: they are slight and only just kept moving. The request opposes that deficiency with the language of a fully completed measure.

subchannels.name: Charity exceeds the exchange and preserves recompense
subchannels.scene_or_process: A request for gratuitous giving is placed beside an economy in which good action and its recompense are not lost.
subchannels.active_motifs: charitable transfer of wealth `quranic:root_000852:B006/m01`; recompense for action `quranic:root_000244:B001/m01`; wage or reward `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; beneficent action `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`; loss and disappearance `quranic:root_000923:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Charity breaks the symmetry of sale by supplying value without equivalent return. The later declaration of preserved reward reframes such surplus as a recompense that does not disappear even when it is not repaid by its human recipient.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Deficient goods and material harm enter an economy where completion and gratuitous giving exceed strict exchange.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: What is barely pushed along under scarcity is answered by full measure, then by a gift that is not reducible to price.

parent_channels.name: P5 (12:77-93): Recognition converts error into reconciliation

subchannels.name: Knowledge overturns ignorance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A question reconnects present recognition to actions once performed without knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: lack of knowledge `quranic:root_000271:B001/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Recognition is framed epistemically before it is framed emotionally. The revealed brother asks the others to reread their past as action shaped by ignorance.

subchannels.name: Favor is joined to protective patience
subchannels.scene_or_process: Divine favor is interpreted through self-protection and restraint whose reward is not permitted to disappear.
subchannels.active_motifs: bestowal that can be acknowledged as favor `quranic:root_001449:B003/m01`; placing oneself under protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`; holding the self from panic `quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`; loss and disappearance `quranic:root_000923:B001/m01`; recompense for labor `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; beneficent action `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The reversal is not narrated as naked triumph. Favor is made continuous with protective discipline, and the surviving outcome is read as recompense preserved through a long interval.

subchannels.name: Confessed preference ends in non-reproach
subchannels.scene_or_process: The brothers confess wrongful preference and sin; Joseph cancels reproach and invokes covering mercy.
subchannels.active_motifs: preferential choosing `quranic:root_000011:B005/m01`; culpable error `quranic:root_000420:B002/m01`; blame that enumerates a fault `quranic:root_000197:B001/m01`; covering a fault and its consequence `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; tender mercy `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Confession names both distorted preference and culpable action. The reply does not deny the past; it refuses to keep it active as enumerated blame and transfers its remaining effect into divine covering and mercy.

subchannels.name: A garment is dispatched as restorative contact
subchannels.scene_or_process: The shirt is carried away, cast onto a face, expected to restore sight, and followed by the gathering of the household.
subchannels.active_motifs: going and passing away `quranic:root_000522:B006/m01`; worn shirt `quranic:root_001256:B001/m01`; casting an object `quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`; face and forward surface `quranic:root_001630:B001/m01`; eyesight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; gathering what was dispersed `quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`; community of close belonging `quranic:root_000064:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Pardon becomes transport. A garment marked by Joseph's embodied presence is sent to make contact with the absent father, and its promised effect extends from restored sight to restored household assembly.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Recognized identity transforms past ignorance into confession, protective patience, pardon, and a transported means of restoration.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Reconciliation does not stop at speech; it dispatches a garment to act on an absent face and then gather the household.

parent_channels.name: P6 (12:94-111): Mediated signs make the absent present

subchannels.name: Scent precedes the arriving caravan
subchannels.scene_or_process: The caravan's departure releases an odor that is perceived at a distance and contested as weakened judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: departure from a place `quranic:root_001159:B010/m01`; provision-bearing caravan `quranic:root_001066:B007/m01`; finding by perception `quranic:root_001626:B001/m02`; odor and scent `quranic:root_000609:B004/m01`; blame that weakens judgment `quranic:root_001179:B003/m01`; old age that impairs judgment `quranic:root_001179:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The first sign of return is neither sight nor speech but scent detached from its source. Perception crosses the distance before the caravan does, while the anticipated objection recodes that sensing as cognitive weakness.

subchannels.name: Good news and cast contact restore vision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bearer arrives, casts the transmitted token onto the face, and sight returns with renewed knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: news that opens the skin with joy `quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`; casting an object `quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`; face and forward surface `quranic:root_001630:B001/m01`; restoration to a prior state `quranic:root_000555:B001/m01`; eyesight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; disclosed knowledge `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The messenger and the cast contact operate together. Announcement affects the body's surface as joy, while material contact reaches the face and reverses the earlier loss of sight.

subchannels.name: Faults are carried into a petition for covering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Confessed error is reformulated as sin, then entrusted to requested and promised forgiveness.
subchannels.active_motifs: culpable error `quranic:root_000420:B002/m01`; sin and offense `quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`; covering a fault and its consequence `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; tender mercy `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Reconciliation now moves through intercession. The sons' earlier confession is carried into a parental petition, and forgiveness is figured as a covering that protects the offender from the continuing effect of the fault.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Distance is overcome by sensory trace, carried contact, good news, and petition, allowing absent persons and faults to become actionable.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Scent arrives before the body, and good news is lexically an event that opens the skin before the garment restores the eye.

parent_channels.name: P6 (12:94-111): Household positions are physically reordered

subchannels.name: Collective entry is secured by shelter
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parents and household are gathered into shelter, directed across a city boundary, and promised settled security.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining a sheltering side `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; compassionate shelter `quranic:root_000070:B002/m01`; entry into an interior `quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`; bounded city `quranic:root_001428:B003/m01`; heart settled in security `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; parental nurture `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Reunion is first an access operation. The parents are drawn near, the household crosses into Egypt, and movement terminates in a condition of security rather than another temporary lodging.

subchannels.name: Raised throne and lowered bodies establish relation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parents are elevated onto a royal seat while the family falls in a bowed posture before Joseph.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical raising `quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`; elevation of rank `quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`; elevated royal seat `quranic:root_001000:B001/m01`; falling with motion and sound `quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`; lowering in submission `quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`; bending the head `quranic:root_000675:B004/m01`; parental nurture `quranic:root_000007:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene differentiates two motions: the parents are raised, and the assembled family lowers itself. Together they materialize a hierarchy that preserves parental honor while realizing the dream's directed posture.

subchannels.name: Dream returns as actual outcome
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prior vision is identified as having returned to its terminus and been made reality.
subchannels.active_motifs: return to final outcome `quranic:root_000067:B002/m01`; dream vision `quranic:root_000531:B003/m01`; temporal precedence `quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`; making a thing into a condition `quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`; reality-matching truth `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; establishing truth `quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Fulfillment is expressed as both interpretation and manufacture. The dream has crossed into its terminus, but that terminus is also said to have been made true through the intervening sequence.

subchannels.name: Confinement and distance are reread as reunion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Exit from prison and arrival from the open country are gathered into a repaired sibling relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: beneficent action `quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`; exit to the outside `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; prison confinement `quranic:root_000678:B001/m01`; open country opposed to settlement `quranic:root_000097:B002/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The final household arrangement gathers two formerly separated geographies: Joseph exits confinement, and the family comes from the open country. Reunion is the common terminus of both movements.

subchannels.name: Subtle repair answers relational disruption
subchannels.scene_or_process: Incitement that damaged the relation is opposed by a fine, hidden mode of gentleness that reconnects the parties.
subchannels.active_motifs: rebellious estrangement `quranic:root_000796:B004/m01`; corruption of relations `quranic:root_001490:B001/m01`; piercing provocation by speech `quranic:root_001490:B002/m01`; connection between parties `quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`; gentle beneficence `quranic:root_001356:B001/m01`; smallness, fineness, and hidden operation `quranic:root_001356:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The rupture is described as an attack on the space between brothers. Its answer is not a matching display of force but a fine operation whose hidden scale becomes visible only in the restored relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Entry, elevation, prostration, fulfilled vision, and retrospective narration place a dispersed household into a newly intelligible arrangement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The completed dream is not static symmetry; it is the visible terminus of sheltering, raising, falling, exiting, and subtle relational repair.
